sentences.en: A This book will provide a detailed examination of the Little Ice Age and other climatic shifts, but, before I embark on that, let me provide a historical context.
sentences.zh: 这本书将详细探讨小冰时代和其他气候变化,但在我着手之前,请允许我介绍一个历史背景。

sentences.en: We tend to think of climate – as opposed to weather – as something unchanging, yet humanity has been at the mercy of climate change for its entire existence, with at least eight glacial episodes in the past 730,000 years.
sentences.zh: 我们往往认为气候 — — 而不是天气 — — 是不变的,然而人类在其整个存在过程中一直受气候变化的左右,在过去的730 000年中至少有8起冰川事件。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Our ancestors adapted to the universal but irregular global warming since the end of the last great Ice Age, around 10,000 years ago, with dazzling opportunism.
sentences.zh: 经历了全球普遍但非正常的变暖也就是我们祖先们适应了上一个冰河时代结束以来的全球变暖大约在一万年前

sentences.en: They developed strategies for surviving harsh drought cycles, decades of heavy rainfall or unaccustomed cold; adopted agriculture and stock-raising, which revolutionised human life; and founded the world’s first pre-industrial civilisations in Egypt, Mesopotamia and the Americas.
sentences.zh: 他们制定了战略,以生存严酷的干旱周期、数十年的暴雨或不习惯的寒冷;通过了农业和畜牧业,使人类生活发生革命;并在埃及、美索不达米亚和美洲建立了世界上第一个工业化前文明。

sentences.en: B The Little Ice Age lasted from roughly 1300 until the middle of the nineteenth century.

sentences.en: Only two centuries ago, Europe experienced a cycle of bitterly cold winters; mountain glaciers in the Swiss Alps were the lowest in recorded memory, and pack ice surrounded Iceland for much of the year.

sentences.en: The climatic events of the Little Ice Age did more than help shape the modern world.

sentences.en: They are the deeply important context for the current unprecedented global warming.

sentences.en: The Little Ice Age was far from a deep freeze, however; rather an irregular seesaw of rapid climatic shifts, few lasting more than a quarter-century, driven by complex and still little understood interactions between the atmosphere and the ocean.
sentences.zh: 然而,小冰时代远未达到深度冻结;相反,它只是由大气和海洋之间复杂和鲜为人知的互动所驱动的、持续时间不超过四分之一个世纪的不规则的快速气候变化观察。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The seesaw brought cycles of intensely cold winters and easterly winds, then switched abruptly to years of heavy spring and early summer rains, mild winters, and frequent Atlantic storms, or to periods of droughts, light northeasterly winds, and summer heat waves.
sentences.zh: 锯锯带来严寒的冬季和东风循环,然后突然转向春春和夏初暴雨、温和的冬季和频繁的大西洋风暴,或干旱、东北轻风和夏季热浪。

sentences.en: C Reconstructing the climate changes of the past is extremely difficult, because systematic weather observations began only a few centuries ago, in Europe and North America.

sentences.en: Millions of hectares of forest and woodland fell before the newcomers’ axes between 1850 and 1890, as intensive European farming methods expanded across the world.
sentences.zh: 1850年至1890年,随着欧洲密集耕作方法在世界各地推广,数百万公顷的森林和林地在新来者轴线之前倒塌。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The unprecedented land clearance released vast quantities of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere, triggering for the first time humanly caused global warming.
sentences.zh: 前所未有的土地清理工作将大量二氧化碳释放到大气中,首次引发人为造成的全球变暖。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Temperatures climbed more rapidly in the twentieth century as the use of fossil fuels proliferated and greenhouse gas levels continued to soar.
sentences.zh: 随着化石燃料的利用激增和温室气体水平继续飙升,二十世纪的温度上升速度更快。

sentences.en: The rise has been even steeper since the early 1980s.
sentences.zh: 自1980年代初以来,上升幅度甚至更大幅度。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The Little Ice Age has given way to a new climatic regime, marked by prolonged and steady warming.
sentences.zh: 冰河时代已经让位给新的气候体制,其特点是长期和持续变暖。
